television.x: The television is a [[furniture|furniture]] item available to the player at the start of the game.

The television can be used by the player to learn tips and tricks about Coral Island and its environment. It can also be used to view the forecast for the following day, in case players wish to plan around it.
It also features a variety of story-based shows to entertain the player.

r: Game of Cones is a cooking competition show between two chefs.
A cow named Mooq eats and rates several barn foods.
Displays the [[weather|weather]] for the following day.
The C-Pop group Coral Stars showcase their skills in front of the judges, but quickly find they overestimated themselves,
[[paul|Paul]], [[anne|Anne]], and [[zoe|Zoe]] document the wildlife of Coral Island and find a wild bird nearby.
Provides tips and tricks surrounding [[foraging|foraging]], [[fishing|fishing]], and insect [[catching|catching]].
[[jeff-smith|Jeff Smith]] provides tips and tricks surrounding [[farming|farming]].
A comedy-mystery channel surrounding the adventures of the masked detective.
Informs the player of news about Coral Island.
Provides the player with alerts of new items available at shops around Coral Island.
hosted by Conny O'Brien. It is a parody/reference the character Cloud Strife from Final Fantasy.
